question: Sreejesh P.R who was awarded “Major Dyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021” is associated with which sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sreejesh P.R **is a professional **field hockey** player from India and is considered one of the best goalkeepers in the world.
 
• He has been a part of the Indian national hockey team for many years and has played a crucial role in several important victories.
 
• Sreejesh has won several awards and accolades throughout his career, including the Arjuna Award in 2015 and the Padma Shri in 2019.
 
• The Major Dyan Chand Khel Ratna Award is the highest sporting honor in India, and Sreejesh was awarded this prestigious award in 2021 for his outstanding contribution to Indian hockey.

• Football - This is not the correct option as Sreejesh P.R is not associated with football. He is a field hockey player.
